title: Design System: CarCy 3D Shop

display.purpose: Single variable family; display 64/40px, sections 48/32px, cards 24px, lead 20/18px, body 16px, labels 14px; weights 400/500.

motion.name: storefront-ease-out
motion.purpose: Framer Motion entrances and shared default transitions.

motion.name: storefront-default
motion.purpose: Fallback Framer Motion duration; individual interactions override it.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: One-time visible-on-server section and collection arrivals.

motion.name: sibling-stagger
motion.purpose: Spacing between siblings in a revealed list or dialog.

motion.name: catalog-layout
motion.purpose: Product filter/sort layout and presence transition, without index delay; initial grid arrival uses the entrance and sibling-stagger timings.

motion.name: color-preview
motion.purpose: Overlapping entrance and exit between concept color renders.

motion.name: contact-feedback
motion.purpose: Contact action hover lift and press feedback.

motionPolicy.direction: Owner-requested Framer Motion on a Taste-guided physical-product shop.
motionPolicy.controls: Session-local manual pause/resume, live system reduced-motion changes, document visibility, and offscreen loop suspension.
motionPolicy.fallback: Server-rendered content stays visible; one-time entrances start after hydration and intersection.
motionPolicy.ownership: Shared preferences and reusable effects in src/components/shared; feature compositions remain in their modules.

narrative.northStar: A clear, product-led CarCy shop redesigned with Taste guidance.
narrative.overview: White product-stage hero, neutral collection, orange personalization, original-logo story, and wordmark close.
dos: Use the single Rethink Sans scale with readable 16px body and 14px labels.
Keep shared shadcn primitives and controlled Framer Motion.
Identify concept imagery and unconfirmed prices honestly.
donts: Shrink controls or create section-specific heading scales.
Invent a checkout, stock, prices, reviews, or a product backend.

implementationStatus: Taste-guided redesign over the existing modular-monolith storefront; concept data and Facebook inquiry flow.
